method: Prospective normal-approximation sizing for paired replicate-cluster contrasts with a two-sided Bonferroni allocation of 0.05/7 per registered primary estimand; 20 clusters is frozen as a conservative round-up above the approximation and must not be reduced after outcomes are observed.
assumptions: The independent unit is one fresh-world replicate cluster, not a personality lane or cell.
The minimum relevant paired cluster difference is 3 Core-3 stages on the 0-30 replicate-arm scale.
The standard deviation of a paired cluster difference is at most 3 Core-3 stages.
All three personality lanes are summed before any registered contrast is formed.
This is an assumption-driven prospective calculation; it does not claim an empirical variance estimate from the historical unpaired runs.
